manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the black box with smooth surface and put it in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.

Task description: The target is the smooth black box with yellow graphics on the left; the container is the central yellow rectangular basket with two black handles. At completion, the black box must be inside and the loaded basket raised.

Success criteria: The black box must be inside the basket, close to and touching its body, with no table contact. Both box and basket must be clearly raised above their starting positions, with the opening upright and without excessive sideways tilt. Putting the box in a basket still on the table is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- The black box has a smooth surface. Open and close across its narrower dimension, gripping flat middle sections of the two opposing long sides and avoiding corners. Open slightly wider than the grasp section and confirm the fingers are actually on both sides before closing.
- The black handles occupy part of the basket opening. Choose an unobstructed gap for the black box and gripper. If rotation is needed, adjust above the rim with clearance to avoid striking handles or jamming at the rim.
- For the basket, grasp a continuous solid section of the yellow upper rim with one finger inside and one outside. Avoid slots, handle attachments, and the black box inside to obtain full pad contact.
- Before releasing the black box, obtain support from the basket bottom to prevent bouncing or flipping after an airborne drop. Keep the basket opening up and move steadily when lifting to reduce box sliding and basket tipping.
